dialogue.text: Hello! I am so sorry to barge in. My son and I are looking for some shelter, do you happen to have some food to spare?
Shush now, Haru… We will be okay, mother will always protect you.

options.text: Nice to meet the two of you.

dialogue.text: Likewise, well listen… we're running low on food and have been needing a shelter, do you happen to have any room here?

options.text: Yes, but you must play against me.

dialogue.text: I see… Whatever it takes, I will keep my family safe.
